scope: SYS-12 Docker Agent restart/recreate persistence; no API, Docker, process, Task, Node, User, Artifact, Transfer, or policy actions performed

source_conclusions.plain_docker_mode: DetectDeploymentMode maps .dockerenv/container cgroup to docker; HostIntegrationFromMode is true only for docker_host_integration. Plain Docker therefore reports HostIntegration false.
source_conclusions.ordinary_command: Runner buildCmd executes Command with /bin/sh -c (internal/agent/execution/runner.go:170-175); image-rootfs proposal includes /bin/sh with SHA a6f559e00b69a4aa9d8cb607be18d9386c5aee55c509e2c075549dcf00e00fc7. The imported image evidence confirms seven source files match, but a fresh read-only TAR/image check is still required before relying on shell availability.
source_conclusions.local_scheduler: Agent capabilities advertise CapLocalScheduler for all modes; desired sync upserts schedules, commits revision, reloads local schedules; Hub sync includes disabled schedules for matched tasks (internal/agent/agent.go:224, 841-923; internal/hub/sync.go:143-155). NoHost is not a scheduler capability blocker.
source_conclusions.journal_and_identity: Run handling writes an execution journal before execution; local identity, global revision, schedule and execution state live in LocalStore under configured DataDir (internal/agent/agent.go:951-980; internal/agent/store.go:50-130). DataDir defaults to /var/lib/nodesteer (cmd/agent/main.go:30-45).
source_conclusions.application_prefetch: Assigned Apps are included in desired sync; post-commit sync calls prefetchApplications regardless of HostIntegration. Prefetch downloads to DataDir/artifacts, verifies SHA, atomically renames and records the local artifact row. Docker plain mode advertises ApplicationDeploy=false, so prefetch-only may be testable without deploy; this is excluded from the minimal SYS-12 flow and remains a separate unverified dimension (internal/hub/sync.go:186-198; internal/agent/agent.go:924-945; internal/agent/artifact.go:19-123).

pinned_image_evidence.known_limit: Image config and imported source hashes are recorded. This does not prove that a nonroot container can write its mounted DataDir or that an Agent reconnects/persists state; the helper is read-only and does not create a container.

readonly_helper.purpose: Inspect exact pinned image metadata, exact candidate-name collisions, pinned rootfs TAR members/SHA, and private original-config key presence only; never emits config values or Docker environment data.
readonly_helper.remote_actions: docker image inspect plus exact per-candidate docker container/volume/network inspect, lstat/read-only SHA and tar metadata; no collection listing, container create/start/stop, volume/network mutation, API, signal, or file writes.
readonly_helper.identity_warning: Original private config's agent_id presence is metadata only. Source supports first HELLO with the existing registration token, fresh NodeName, and omitted/empty AgentID; Hub then generates new IDs/credential and Agent persists them under its new DataDir. No Admin enrollment POST or returned secret is needed; never reuse or alter the original config/AgentID. Recheck NodeName uniqueness via Admin GET before startup. Source: internal/agent/agent.go:191-208,380-400; internal/agent/connection/manager.go:252-261; internal/hub/gateway.go:343-405; internal/hub/node.go:163-201.
readonly_helper.compile_status: Python compile() succeeded locally without executing helper; source SHA256 53ecdaa900297673794a64b6091c95a87507826e89357def7ba604af5e1f5fc7. Root, private directory and config path are exact pinned/no-symlink/owner/mode guarded; config opens O_NOFOLLOW and is bounded to 1MiB, values never emitted. Candidate collisions use exact per-name inspect only, and absence requires 'No such' response. TAR member reads are gated on exact archive SHA and support only explicit rootfs/ or direct-root entries. No Native2 helper/API/Docker call was made.
